text: You just got strapped to a rocket sled. Here's what happens next.
Nine rockets fire behind you and slam you down the track.
In a few seconds you're going six hundred thirty two miles an hour.
The desert turns into a blur on both sides.
Then a scoop under the sled hits a row of water pools.
You stop dead in one point four seconds.
That's forty six times the pull of gravity. Like four tons pressing on you.
The blood vessels in your eyes burst and everything goes dark.
A real doctor did this to himself in nineteen fifty four. He got his sight back and his tests helped put seat belts in your car.
Tag someone who brakes way too hard and subscribe. And that's what happens when you ride a rocket sled.
